Name: S.Space
Tagline: Your team and everyone's AI agents, in one workspace
Description: Everyone on your team has an AI agent, and none of them work together, so you copy, paste and re-explain all day. S.Space is one workspace for your team and everyone's agents. Bring the ones you already use, like Claude Code and Codex, from any vendor. Agents reach out, hand work to each other and bring you finished results, with shared memory so you explain things once. Agents act, you approve what matters. Free to start. Built by the team behind AutoGen.

Name: Toone
Tagline: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier
Description: Toone: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier. Build precise agentic workflows and routines in natural language. Each node is an agent's chat thread on the model you pick (ChatGPT or Claude), or an automatic step that runs the same way every time without AI. Run repeatable routines, babysit them with agents, polish as they run, pause and continue anytime. Plus live share, meeting notes, Spotlight-style layouts, Zen Mode, Calendar, Quick Capture, Git, and MCPs for research, SEO and more.

Name: Review Box
Tagline: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests
Description: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests. Track reviewed files, jump to symbol definitions and uses, search the whole PR and ask AI about changes.

Name: Arcade
Tagline: AI video generator for marketing teams
Description: Arcade is the AI video generator for marketing teams. Describe what you want, answer two questions, and get an on-brand product video in minutes. Start from a prompt, a screen recording, or what you already have in Notion, Linear, Google Drive, GitHub, and Granola. Your Brand Kit, natural voiceover, and every scene editable. Then post straight to YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. Free to start.

Name: Dippr
Tagline: A data platform served to your agents, with one prompt
Description: It’s where your agents build and run your company’s software, tools and apps – with access to your company data across sources, the context to understand it, and the rules to use it safely.

Name: GPT-6.2 Astra
Tagline: OpenAI's frontier model for your hardest projects
Description: GPT-6.2 Astra is OpenAI's new frontier model for your hardest projects. It writes slides, spreadsheets and documents that follow your templates and read less like AI, builds better looking websites, games and 3D designs, and sets new highs on science evals. OpenAI says it scores 5.2 points above GPT-6 Astra on Agents' Last Exam at less than a third of the cost. Available now in ChatGPT Work and Codex, and in the API as gpt-6.2-astra. GPT-6.2 Sol launches alongside it for everyday work.

Name: Qwen4-Max
Tagline: Qwen's new flagship for long-running agent work
Description: Qwen4-Max is the first flagship built on Qwen's new 2.4T-parameter architecture, with native vision and a 1M-token context window. It supports coding, professional workflows, and long-running agent tasks, with API access available now.

Name: UI Verify
Tagline: Visual testing for coding agents
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: UI Verify shows your coding agent every screen its change touched, so the agent catches and fixes its own UI bugs before your users see them. Used by teams at JetBrains, Cura and Metica. Works with Playwright, Storybook, Vitest and Bun, and with iOS and Android apps. Set up in one line. Free to start, and free for open source: 50,000 snapshots a month.

Name: Tencent Hy4 flash
Tagline: Fast, low-cost model from $0.07/M input
Description: Hy4 flash is Tencent’s most cost-effective Hy model to date, with 224B total parameters, 12B active, multimodal input and a 1M-token context. Per Tencent, it decodes above 150 tokens per second and costs about $0.07 per million input tokens and $0.28 output. It targets everyday tasks like document work, slides, deep research and computer use, while Hy4 handles harder engineering. Open-sourcing is planned, but the weights are not out yet.

Name: Polylane for CI
Tagline: Fix broken builds before they block your team
Description: When CI fails on main or in your merge queue, Polylane reads the job logs, finds the commit that broke the build, and opens a fix pull request. It runs your build and tests before review, fixes CI failures on its own PRs, and closes the issue when main is green again. Works with GitHub Actions, Depot, and CI that reports checks to GitHub.

Name: SaaS Toolkit MCP
Tagline: An SDR and CMO on your site 24/7, for one JavaScript snippet
Description: Drop one JavaScript snippet on your site. SaaS Toolkit becomes your 24/7 sales and marketing arm: • AI chat steps in when a visitor is ready to buy or about to leave • Anonymous visitors become named leads • Emails triggered by what they do • Stripe revenue, Slack alerts, ad conversions, webhooks • Add the Website SDR: it calls hot leads and books meetings New: the MCP. Your AI agents run it from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: ask, reply, follow up. MCP included on every plan, even free Starter.

Name: ICONS
Tagline: Where brands book creators, or license their AI likeness
Description: ICONS is where brands book creators, influencers and celebrities for sponsored posts, or license a creator's likeness for AI content. Creators set their rates and approve every script and final cut. Contracts and payments live in one place.

Name: uRun
Tagline: Real-time decisions for voice and video agents
Description: Sense is a real-time decision model for voice and video agents. It runs on streaming audio and video and answers your questions about the conversation many times per second: is the user done speaking, did they just interrupt, should the agent stop talking. You write the questions, Sense returns the decisions, and your agent acts on them. Build with the SDK for real-time sessions, or send single requests to explore. New accounts start with 1,000 in free credits.

Name: Waldo by Wherobots
Tagline: The AI agent that accelerates engineering with spatial data
Topics: Amazon, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics
Description: Waldo is the geospatial data agent that turns questions about the physical world into answers, maps, and production-ready data pipelines. It analyzes satellite imagery, geometries, geography data, and your organization's first party data, writes and debugs the analysis, and delivers results in hours. When the work needs to run continuously, Waldo turns it into a scheduled pipeline on your existing data platform. Built for spatial analytics at scale by the creators of Apache Sedona.

Name: Incredible Agents
Tagline: Proactive AIs that do work directly on your computer, 24/7
Description: The heavily asked for INCREDIBLE AGENTS update is finally here! Your voice can now: (1) CREATE new agents that work directly on your computer, in apps, browsers and files. (2) RUN work on repeat, 24/7. (3) BUILD live sharable pages, dashboards, apps and more. Incredible PROACTIVELY FINDS WORK AI agents can do for you, and sets the agent up. Agents do the work directly on your computer, the way you do, 24/7. FREE TO TRY. Mac and Windows.

Name: dusk bot
Tagline: free open source Grok bot alternative
Topics: Productivity, Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Best free Grok bot alternative. Use the ChatGPT, Claude or Grok plan you already pay for and get a team of bots, each with a job, a memory you can edit and its own computer. They run on a schedule, ask before risky steps, and live in a calm, polished chat app. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, OpenRouter or a local model, on your own sign-in. 100% free and open source

Name: Replay QA Self-healing Mode
Tagline: Turn user frustration into verified fixes
Description: Self-healing Mode turns frustrated user sessions into root-caused bug reports with evidence, sent to your issue tracker or straight to your coding agent. - always-on user session capture (powered by Fullstory) - automatic detection of user frustration signals - Bug reports with detailed root-cause analysis + runtime evidence - pipe them into your issue tracker of choice or straight to your coding agent or factory loop - Daily summary reports of what users did

Name: worldinmotion
Tagline: Encrypted messages between AI agents, across vendors
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Open-source, end-to-end encrypted messaging between AI agent sessions (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, any MCP client) across machines, built to cross accounts. The relay sees only metadata, never the text. No account, no telemetry. Set up with: npx worldinmotion setup

Name: Introzy
Tagline: Track referrals from intro to commission
Description: Track every introduction from handshake to commission. Introzy captures referrals, attributes revenue, and pays partners on time - free to start.

Name: Bluedot Phone Calls
Tagline: AI note taker for phone calls
Description: Bluedot now covers phone calls, not just meetings. Dial from the web or mobile app, keep your own caller ID, and get a transcript, summary and action items automatically.
